extracted.intended_audience: educators and grant writers (especially those running proposal-writing workshops and writing vote-curriculum proposals)
extracted.subtask_description: Materials and exercises for running proposal-writing workshops and for developing/writing educational program (vote curriculum) proposals that conform to federal guidelines. Focuses on drafting goals, objectives, evaluation methods, activities, and addressing federal guideline areas (needs, objectives, plan, results, capability, personnel, budget).

rubrics_metrics.name: Revising Rough Drafts into Short and Simple Texts
rubrics_metrics.description: Exercise aimed at revising initial drafts so they become short and simple texts appropriate for proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This exercise can be used by educators wishing to conduct a proposal writing workshop centered around the development and writing of acceptable goals, objectives, evaluation methods, and activities for the project proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptable goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Development and writing of acceptable goals for the project proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the workshop exercise: educators use the exercise to craft goals suitable for inclusion in project proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Development and writing of acceptable objectives for the project proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in the workshop-focused exercise to ensure objectives are suitable for proposal review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Development and writing of acceptable evaluation methods to measure proposal outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshop exercise centers on producing evaluation methods appropriate for the project proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Development and writing of acceptable activities to implement the proposal plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshop exercise includes crafting activities that align with goals, objectives, and evaluation methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Needs and problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Addressing the 'needs and problems' area as required by federal guidelines for vote curriculum proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The second research exercise is intended for educators writing proposals in light of federal guidelines; the actual federal guidelines quoted from the Federal Register are reproduced in the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectives (federal guideline area)
rubrics_metrics.description: Responding to the 'objectives' section as specified by federal guidelines for curriculum proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the exercise guidance and reproduced Federal Register text to formulate objectives that meet federal expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Describing the project 'plan' consistent with federal guidelines for proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The exercise illustrates how to write the plan section in accordance with the reproduced federal guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifying expected 'results' as required by federal proposal guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance and examples in the exercise help authors state measurable or describable results aligned with federal criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Documenting 'institutional capability' to carry out the proposed project per federal guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The exercise and reproduced guidelines inform how to present institutional resources and capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Describing 'personnel' involved in the project as required by federal guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes guidance on how to list and justify staff qualifications consistent with the reproduced Federal Register language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing the 'budget' section to satisfy federal proposal guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The second exercise shows how budget information should be presented in light of the federal criteria reproduced in the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conformity to Federal Register guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Using and following the federal guidelines quoted from the Federal Register when preparing vote curriculum proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The actual federal guidelines are reproduced in the document to be followed when composing the needs, objectives, plan, results, institutional capability, personnel, and budget sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of acceptable local questionnaires
rubrics_metrics.description: Employing samples of acceptable local questionnaires for needs assessment or related proposal components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document reproduces samples of acceptable local questionnaires that can be used as models in proposal development.
